slides.title: The 10th house
slides.subtitle: Your work, your name, your place in the sky

slides.label: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 11.11
slides.quote:
From the 10th, read status,
livelihood, honour
and the father.
slides.sanskrit: rājyaṃ cākāśaṃvṛttiṃ ca mānaṃ caiva pitustathā
body: Parashara calls it the place in the sky.

slides.label: What lives here
slides.title: Work and name
items: What you do for a living
What people call you when you leave the room
The 10th is read for him too

slides.label: Why the top
slides.title:
The highest point
of your chart
body: At noon the Sun stands high in the sky. The 10th house is that high point: the part of you everyone can see.
slides.note: Sutram’s reading, built on the classical meanings

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
Who sits in
your 10th?
body: Count to the 10th sign from your rising sign. The grahas there, and the lord of that sign, show the work you are known for.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Your name at work
items: Do one thing people can point to
Finish it where others can see
Let it speak when you are not in the room

slides.title:
What do people call
you at work?
